environment.description: ECS Fargate service in a VPC with public subnets. The SQS queue has a resource policy allowing sqs:SendMessage from any AWS principal (Principal: '*'). The queue is a standard SQS queue accessible via the public SQS API endpoint. The RDS PostgreSQL instance is in the same VPC with security group allowing inbound from the ECS task security group. No input validation is performed at the queue level.

config.network: public subnets with IGW, NAT gateway for outbound
config.rds_instance: PostgreSQL 14, private subnet, SG allows ECS task SG on port 5432
